# redirhub_domain_verification (Resource)

Waits until a domain's DNS points to RedirHub. Create it after the DNS records and make the links that need the domain depend on it. It changes nothing in RedirHub, and destroying it only removes it from the state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "redirhub_domain" "go" {
  host        = "go.example.com"
  short_links = true
}

resource "cloudflare_dns_record" "redirhub" {
  for_each = { for r in redirhub_domain.go.dns_records : "${r.type}-${r.name}" => r }

  zone_id = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name    = each.value.name
  type    = each.value.type
  content = each.value.value
  ttl     = 300
}

# Waits until the records above are live, so the links below are served from the first request.
resource "redirhub_domain_verification" "go" {
  host       = redirhub_domain.go.host
  timeout    = "15m"
  depends_on = [cloudflare_dns_record.redirhub]
}

resource "redirhub_link" "spring" {
  handler      = "short-url"
  host         = redirhub_domain_verification.go.host
  alias        = "spring"
  destinations = ["https://example.com/spring"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) The domain to wait for, usually `redirhub_domain.<name>.host`.

### Optional

- `timeout` (String) How long to wait, e.g. `10m` (the default) or `1h`. DNS changes can take a while to reach every resolver.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
